newsitem.title: INDIA: India approves Shipping Corp tanker deal.
newsitem.headline: India approves Shipping Corp tanker deal.

text.p: The Indian government on Monday approved a proposal by state-owned Shipping Corp of India (SCI) to buy two crude oil tankers for $42.10 million each, a spokesman said.
Shipping Corp will buy the tankers from South Korea's Halla Engineering and Heavy Industries Ltd, an affiliate of the Halla Group, he said.
The aframax tankers will have a capacity of 110,000 dry weight tonnage (dwt) each.
SCI will turn to external commercial borrowing for 70 percnt of the cost, the spokesman said. The remainder will be sourced internally, he added.
